newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm, blue chips active.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm, blue chips active.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were lifted on Friday by a firmer Wall Street opening and some buying in blue chips, dealers said.
By 1430 GMT the Nikkei/ISE 50 index stood at 1,641.98 points, up 6.75 points or 0.41 percent from Thursday's London close.

Earlier in Tokyo the 225-share Nikkei average shed its opening gains and closed down 101.01 points, or 0.49 percent, at 20,523.75 in the usual cautious trading the day most companies hold their shareholders' meetings.
"Generally firmer but a fairly quiet day, except some blue chips", one trader said.
Sony Corp. was the most actively traded stocks, he said. It slipped five yen to 9,990 yen.
Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp was also in the centre of interest after the company announced it would buy back two series of eurodollar convertible bonds.
Mitsubishi Trust eased 17.50 yen to 1,800 yen.
Banks remained a main feature but profit-taking would continue, dealers said.
Fuji Bank fell 55 yen to 1,740 yen and Sanwa Bank slipped 55 yen to 1,665 yen.
